IsolatedSessions.description: Default mode: single RuntimeProfile can drive all 4 roles via independent sessions
requirements: fresh AgentSession per role (no resume across roles)
role-appropriate permissions (Reviewer read-only, Evaluator no writes)
context isolation (Planner gets GoalSpec, Executor gets Plan+Task, Reviewer gets candidate digest, Evaluator gets Evidence Ledger)
Candidate fixed at review time (digest + diff + evidence)

StrictProfileDiversity.description: Optional high-assurance mode: Planner != Evaluator, Executor != Reviewer
